d: Steve McGarrett investigates the death of a young Asian girl on a flight from Bangkok to Honolulu. The girl was a heroin courier for a drug ring in Singapore. McGarrett sets out to dismantle the operation and uncover the truth behind the girl's death.
Gibbs and the team work to clear the name of a Navy medic killed in Iraq, who is the prime suspect in a murder in his hometown.  (TV-PG)
When a letter sealed with a kiss is delivered to NCIS, Tony assumes it's for him and opens it, only to release a mysterious powder into the squad room.  (TV-PG)
Gibbs' worst fears are confirmed when he learns that his nemesis, Arab/Israeli double agent Ari (Rudolf Martin), is back in Washington D.C. on assignment to kill him. (TV-PG)
While the NCIS team deals with Kate's death, Gibbs' determination to finally put an end to Ari's (guest star Rudolf Martin) reign of terror mounts.
Ari (guest start Rudolf Martin) continues to wreak havoc on the NCIS team as he uses its members as pawns in the game he is playing with Gibbs.

Under order from the Governor of Virginia, a skeptical Gibbs is forced to meet with a serial killer he helped to convict a decade before under the pretense that the killer will tell Gibbs where he hid missing bodies.
A man Melanie intended to break up with dies, Joy dodges calls from her mother, Victoria tries an ab-toning belt, and Elka and Mamie Sue write roast jokes for a centenarian.
Victoria contacts all her exes to find out what she could have done differently, unexpectedly seeing in-person Julian, the one who broke her heart.
The women's group birthday includes a professor as well as a reunion of Elka and Mamie Sue's bowling team.
At Victoria's bare-bones wedding to Emmet in prison, the officiating tabloid photographer turns out to be Simon, the man who got Joy pregnant as a teenager.
After Alex Trebek introduces the episode, the women are held hostage by Chester, Lily, and a Mrs. Ladypants-loving plastic surgeon.
Following Emmet's escape from prison, Victoria is under close watch by an FBI agent, and Alec's new girlfriend questions Melanie's pregnancy.
As Joy, Owen and Simon lie about their family history to get Wilbur admitted into a prestigious preschool, Elka helps Melanie find a doctor to treat her brain tumor.
Discovering that Emmet faked his own death, Victoria decides to follow suit to be with him, as Simon rethinks his career, and Melanie dates a guy who doesn't spoon correctly.
Her Witches License and a new student bring Sabrina a new set of challenges.
Jealousy gets the best of Sabrina when Harvey starts spending a lot of time with his best friend.
Hilda and Zelda experience a life-changing event when they discover they are adopted.
New charge card from the Other Realm causes Sabrina to forget that the most important things in life can’t be bought.
It’s Halloween, and Sabrina is having a ghoulish time adjusting to her new job at the coffee house.
Sabrina’s new coffeehouse co-worker poses a threat to her relationship with Harvey.
